reading.title: A negative Outlook: Microsoft scrambles to fix email outage
reading.summary: Early Friday, after Outlook had been down for more than 12 hours, Microsoft reported "marginal success."

news.title: U.S. envoys meet with Putin in Moscow on Ukraine talks, then see Zelenskyy in Dublin
news.summary: U.S. envoys have met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin and with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Ireland as Washington seeks new momentum in peace efforts.
